title: Haider's SMPStart
description: Haider's SMPStart Is A Simple Plugin Used To Manage The Start Of SMP!
body:
# 🛠 Haider's SMPStart Plugin
Haider's SMPStart is a Paper plugin that helps you manage the beginning of an SMP with two distinct phases and useful controls.
## 🌍 Phases
**Starting Phase**
- Border is small (configurable)
- PvP is disabled
- Players cannot break blocks
- Peaceful environment to let everyone get ready

**Started Phase**
- Border expands to a larger configurable size
- PvP gets enabled after an optional timer
- The SMP officially begins
## ⌨️ Commands
**/smpstart center** Set the world spawn and border center to your location

**/smpstart starting** Switch back to the starting phase (PvP off, small border)

**/smpstart starting border <size>** Set the border size for the starting phase

**/smpstart start** Start the SMP (expands the border and enables PvP after timer or instantly)

**/smpstart start border <size>** Set the border size for the started phase (can extend it even after SMP has started)
# ⚙️ Configurable Options
- **smp-name** → Name of your SMP 
- **pvp-delay.enabled** → Enable or disable PvP countdown 
- **pvp-delay.seconds** → Time in seconds before PvP turns on 
- **borders.starting-size** → Starting phase border size 
- **borders.start-size** → Started phase border 
- **size borders.transition-seconds** → Time it takes for border to expand 
- **starting-phase.difficulty** → World difficulty in starting phase 
- **starting-phase.gamemode** → Player gamemode in starting phase starting
- **phase.disable-mob-spawning** → Toggle mob spawning in starting phase
- **started-phase.difficulty** → World difficulty in started phase 
- **started-phase.gamemode** → Player gamemode in started phase 
- **start-countdown.enabled** → Enable or disable the 3-2-1 countdown before SMP start
# 🎮 Features
- Easy phase switching between starting and started
- Fully configurable borders, PvP rules, gamemodes, and difficulties
- Option for PvP delay with a visible countdown
- Simple and clean commands (OP/console only)
